## c29d882947ce

**Classification: reproduced teaching defect / shortcut.** No target files were
changed.

Generator SHA-256:
`0e394ae1cdf17f0247b66a4997669ea4d5e184f7a243e8b0c92b58705879553e`.
Executed rule hash: `104bcd0dfb9a`.

The 12-stage battery is 7 green, 2 advisory, and 3 failed; lint, defect lint,
and override fail independently of the semantic finding. More importantly, an
ordinary generated input at seed `9301`, sample index `5`, difficulty `easy`, no
overrides passes the generator’s `self_check` and belongs to its documented
domain, but the actual Racket output is the 3×3 identity matrix. An
“always output identity relation matrix” rival therefore agrees exactly on that
sample even though sample index 0 from the same fixed sequence proves the rival
is globally wrong.

The compact retained counterexample is
`checks/audit/c29d882947ce/identity-shortcut.json`; the supported Racket replay is
`checks/audit/c29d882947ce/identity-racket.json`. Across sample indices 0–63 with
the same seed/band, **14/64** outputs are identity-only. The issue is not an
incorrect label; it is that these lessons provide no off-diagonal rotation
witness and can reinforce an identity shortcut.

Suggested task-local repair: schedule at least one non-identity relation in every
complete lesson and declare identity-only as an executable competitor. The audit
did not patch this target.

## c29d882947ce

**Reproduced teaching shortcut; source left unchanged.** Audited generator
SHA-256
`0e394ae1cdf17f0247b66a4997669ea4d5e184f7a243e8b0c92b58705879553e`,
executed rule hash `104bcd0dfb9a`.

A finite search examined 216 generated grids (seeds 0..8, 24 indices per seed)
and found an ordinary consecutive lesson at seed 8, easy: demonstrations
indices 3, 4, and 5 all have the 3×3 identity matrix as their valid Racket
answer, while query index 6 has
`[[1,0,2],[0,1,0],[2,0,1]]`. The rival “always output the identity matrix with
dimension equal to the component count” therefore fits every demonstration and
fails the query. All four inputs pass selected `self_check`; all four Racket
outputs are valid.

The complete source-bound lesson, search scope, rival outputs, and hashes are in
`checks/audit/c29d882947ce/evidence.json`; supported Racket application is in
`racket.json`. Reusable scripts are `search_lesson.py` and
`finalize_evidence.py`.
